botLinker.title: SakuKu WhatsApp Bot Linker
botLinker.subtitle: Link your WhatsApp to SakuKu Cloud 24/7 without needing a server terminal
botLinker.adminKeyDesc: This endpoint is protected. Enter the key configured in your environment variables.
botLinker.statusOnlineDesc: WhatsApp session is active and ready to receive finance commands 24/7.
botLinker.statusQrDesc: Open WhatsApp on your phone > Linked Devices > Link a Device.
botLinker.statusOfflineDesc: The WhatsApp session is disconnected or the background worker service on Render is currently inactive.
botLinker.troubleshootStep1: Click the "Generate QR Code" or "Restart Worker" button below to restore the session or re-link your device.
botLinker.troubleshootStep2: Ensure the worker service on your Render dashboard is "Live" and the DATABASE_URL variable matches Vercel.
botLinker.troubleshootStep3: If testing locally, make sure npm run worker is running in your terminal.

botLinker.toastStillOffline: Status updated: Worker is still offline
botLinker.toastRequestingQr: Requesting new QR code from worker...

botLinker.badgeWaitingQr: WA Bot: Waiting for QR Scan
botLinker.qrRealtimeDesc: This QR code is automatically updated in real-time from the database
botLinker.step1: Open WhatsApp on your mobile phone.
botLinker.step2: Go to Linked Devices in Settings or the three-dots menu.
botLinker.step3: Tap Link a Device and point your phone's camera at the QR code above.
